meta.name: health-check
meta.description:
System health check dispatched by the activity monitor via Control queue.
Checks PM2 services, disk space, and memory usage.
Use when receiving a control message containing "health-check".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查系统健康状态，包括PM2服务、磁盘和内存
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要定期检查服务器运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Check system health including PM2 services, disk, and memory
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly check server health

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会定期检查系统健康：检查 PM2 服务是否在线、磁盘和内存使用率是否超标，并记录结果或发送警报。
howto.when: 当收到包含“health-check”的控制消息时触发，通常由活动监视器自动定期发送。

say.note: 触发系统健康检查流程。

say.text: 检查 PM2 服务状态。
say.note: 仅执行 PM2 服务检查步骤。

say.text: 报告磁盘和内存使用情况。
say.note: 仅执行磁盘和内存检查步骤。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude periodically checks system health: verifies PM2 services are online, disk and memory usage are within thresholds, and logs results or sends alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered upon receiving a control message containing "health-check", typically enqueued automatically by the activity monitor at regular intervals.

say_en.note: Triggers the system health check process.
Executes only the PM2 service check step.
Executes only the disk and memory check steps.
